# Vendor licenses

| Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| GSAP core + ScrollTrigger, SplitText, Flip, DrawSVGPlugin, MotionPathPlugin, Observer, CustomEase | 3.13.0 | GSAP Standard License |
| Lenis (+ lenis.css) | 1.3.27 | MIT |

**GSAP.** Since 3.13, GSAP is 100% free, including every former "Club" bonus plugin (SplitText, DrawSVG, MorphSVG and the rest), for commercial use too. The terms are the GSAP Standard "No Charge" License: https://gsap.com/standard-license. The main restriction is that you may not use GSAP to build a tool that competes with Webflow's visual animation builder. Keep the license header comments in the `.min.js` files.

**Lenis.** MIT License, Copyright (c) darkroom.engineering. https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis/blob/main/LICENSE

The files are copied unchanged from `node_modules/gsap/dist` and `node_modules/lenis/dist`.
